description: Source code implementing WAN interface policy management, including state machine logic for selecting and managing WAN interfaces, with functions for interface selection, state transitions, and policy enforcement.

methods.name: SelectionTimer
methods.description: Updates the status of WAN interfaces based on timeout and physical status.

methods.name: WanMgr_Policy_FM_SelectWANActive
methods.description: Selects the active WAN interface based on priority and status.

methods.name: WanMgr_StartIfaceStateMachine
methods.description: Starts the interface state machine for the active WAN interface.

methods.name: WanMgr_ResetIfaceTable
methods.description: Resets the interface table by disabling invalid interfaces.

methods.name: Transition_Start
methods.description: Initial transition to start the WAN policy state machine.

methods.name: Transition_WanInterfaceSelected
methods.description: Transition after WAN interface is selected, starts interface state machine.

methods.name: Transition_SelectedInterfaceUp
methods.description: Transition when the selected interface is up, starts interface state machine.

methods.name: Transition_SelectedInterfaceDown
methods.description: Transition when the selected interface is down.

methods.name: State_SelectingWanInterface
methods.description: State for selecting WAN interface based on policy.

methods.name: State_SelectedInterfaceUp
methods.description: State when the WAN interface is active and up.

methods.name: State_SelectedInterfaceDown
methods.description: State when the WAN interface is down.

methods.name: State_WaitingForInterfaceSMExit
methods.description: State waiting for interface state machine to exit, then resets interface table.

methods.name: WanMgr_Policy_PrimaryPriorityOnBootupPolicy
methods.description: Main function implementing the primary priority policy on system bootup, runs a state machine in a separate thread.
